answer: Agents at each node publish a signed marble‑hash of their recent grading vector; every hour a summit of timber‑rooted validators cross‑checks these hashes pairwise, computing mutual information and flagging any pair whose joint entropy stays below a threshold for three consecutive rounds. When a flag triggers, the implicated identities are quarantined and must post a bond equal to ten times the average grading stake, which the attacker must lock up for a 48‑hour waiting period before any identity can rejoin.
